sloka: स बभूव रणो घोरस्तयोर्बाणमयश्चयः।अग्निभ्यामिव दीप्ताभ्यां सत्रे कुशमयश्चयः ।। ६.८९.३५ ।।
transliteration: sa babhūva raṇo ghorastayorbāṇamayaścayaḥ।agnibhyāmiva dīptābhyāṁ satre kuśamayaścayaḥ ।। 6.89.35 ।।

translations.english: The other pointed arrows of both clashed with weapons in the sky in thousands, shattered and tore them.
